description:
Systematic review and improvement of error messages across all platform adapters
and CLI commands.

Recent work (Presto/Trino catalog handling) demonstrated the value of actionable
error messages that suggest next steps. This pattern should be applied consistently
across the codebase.

Focus areas:
- Connection failures (credentials, network, permissions)
- Missing dependencies (optional packages not installed)
- Invalid configuration (wrong parameter combinations)
- Data loading errors (file not found, format mismatch)
